violation_type.title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1311(d))
violation_type.short_title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety
violation_type.typical_finding: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by the director.  The  required training topics are 1. emergency preparedness 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction 5. building and physical premises safety and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

finding_variants.text: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by the director.  The  required training topics are 1. emergency preparedness 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction 5. building and physical premises safety and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

The Program Director was lacking documented training for the following topics for the evaluation year 1/21-12/21:  Administering medication, Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic  reaction, building and physical premises safety and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials

The director is missing the annual trainnigs for; -Emergency preparedness, -Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases -Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, -Understanding building and physical premises safety -Handling, storing, and disposing
The operation director did not receive training in administering medications, handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials for the August 2021-August 2022 training year.
Director did not have annual health and safety trainings available for review at time of inspection.
Annual health and safety trainings were not available for review for program director at time of inspection.
